_note: Gap closure register for the 120 m four-mast concept. Each gap has a checklist. Automated steps are checked by scripts/validate-gap-closure.mjs against the repository; manual steps are closed by evidence added to the repo and marked here. Run: npm run validate:gaps

gaps.title: Weight register has no masses; 1,487 t is not covered

checklist.step: Mass and centre height for every hull, fit-out and systems item, from supplier or schedule data
Register covers at least 95% of the 1,487 t reference

gaps.title: Reference displacement and draft targets are not one set of numbers

checklist.step: Reference displacement, draft and sail stability block all agree (1,487 t, 1.8 m, GM 2.13 m)
Budget validator has no draft or volume flags for the reference

gaps.title: One outline for every deck; no lines plan or waterplane

checklist.step: Lines plan with Cb, Cwp and per-deck outlines (tapered by level)
Per-deck outlines replace the single hull ellipse in layout/hull.json

gaps.title: Stability: KG not calculated; GZ curve and heel limit not done

checklist.step: KG from the weight register, below the KG limit for GM 2.13 m
GZ curve and heel limit against the applicable rules

gaps.title: Endurance: battery-only does not close at 20 kW or above

checklist.step: Real hotel load profile replaces the placeholder loads
Battery-only share at the review load is under 10% of displacement, or the fuel and genset case is recorded as the design basis

gaps.title: Keel and watertight subdivision not reconciled with the hull

checklist.step: Keel and ballast position for the 1.8 m draft
Watertight subdivision drawn on the lines plan

gaps.title: Most room geometry is inferred, not dimensioned

checklist.step: Dimensioned general arrangement for every room on the 120 m hull
Layout regenerated from the dimensioned plan

gaps.title: Roof level assumed; pilot house depends on it

checklist.step: Roof level confirmed on a sheet and entered in layout/accessibility.json

gaps.title: Accessibility rule checks pass on current criteria

checklist.step: validate:access reports no gaps

gaps.title: Tender launch point and bay not placed

checklist.step: Bay and starboard launch point placed on the general arrangement

gaps.title: Sail plan missing; rig is a triangle estimate, clearances use placeholder geometry

checklist.step: Sail plan with real areas, mast stations and boom lengths
Sail clearance file uses the same LOA and beam as layout/hull.json
Sail clearance check passes

gaps.title: Genset exhaust outlet blocked on the pilot-house roof

checklist.step: Owner review of the alternative stern or aft exhaust route
Ventilation register has no blocking problems
Each system in systems.json names its review gate (approval_status) and lists at least one risk

gaps.title: Renders and brief can disagree: new A/V rooms have no interior render

checklist.step: Interior render for each new A/V and entertainment room
Renders regenerated from the current layout (formal chain)
checklist.evidence: drawings/renders/interior/{theatre,cinema,broadcast-main-stage,broadcast-side-stage,broadcast-production-control,av-media-room}.jpg (full quality, 120 m hull); other renders from the formal run d13a90e

gaps.title: Medical and pet accommodation placed on the Tween deck

checklist.step: Medical bay and pet suites are requests on the Tween deck in the envelope budget
Pet suites deck decision (guest or crew) recorded

gaps.title: Site scope register still carries 68 m-era figures

checklist.step: scope.json has no 68 m, 64 m, 806 t or 4.8 m keel figures presented as current

gaps.title: Deck structure and headroom not analysed

checklist.step: Structural analysis of decks, mast foundations and roof live loads
